description: This PHP source file defines the Route class within Drupal's migrate module, responsible for processing and transforming source link_path data into route information for migration purposes. It includes methods for constructing the class, creating instances via dependency injection, and transforming source data into route arrays.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A process plugin class for transforming source link_path data into route information during migration.
